s.note: green guacamole for the ooze canister
s.how: Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes and salt. Fold in half a finely diced red onion, a handful of chopped coriander and 1 chopped red chilli. Press plastic wrap on the surface until serving so it stays green. Serve with 300g corn chips.

s.note: the turtles never stop at one pizza
s.how: Split 12 mini bagels and spread each half with pizza sauce. Top with 200g grated mozzarella and 100g sliced pepperoni and grill until bubbling. Serve hot, straight from the grill.

m.how: Rest 2 balls of pizza dough, about 500g, at room temperature for an hour. Stretch thin, spread with 200ml pizza sauce and top with 250g grated mozzarella, 100g pepperoni, 200g fresh pineapple pieces and 1 sliced jalapeño. Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting for 8 minutes.

w.how: Blend 12 scoops mint choc chip ice cream, about 750ml, with 800ml cold full cream milk until thick and smooth. Pour into four chilled tall glasses and serve with straws.

d.how: Pour 40ml lime cordial into each of four tall glasses packed with ice. Top with soda water, about 250ml each, and hang a lime wheel on the rim.
